notes.title: Garden of Oblivion Update 1.1 – German Translation
notes.content:
Thanks to all of you for your reception of [b]Garden of Oblivion[/b]! I'm very happy to see that a modest little game made in a weekend can still be enjoyed.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32133628/e9e768ad86b641c23c0614bbfc0079ca7823123f.png[/img]

We’ve uploaded a new version of the game with a German translation made by 	[url=http://en.marcel-weyers.de/]Marcel Weyers (many thanks to him)[/url]. We also had to change the UI a bit to fit some of the words but it shouldn't be too visible.
